Atish Dipankar · 10th–11th centuries

About this place

Bajrayogini, also written Vajrayogini, is associated with the scholar whose career linked Bengal with other centres of Buddhist learning and ultimately Tibet. A visit makes most sense alongside Raghurampur and Nateshwar, where excavations have exposed evidence of the region’s Buddhist institutions.

Ask locally for Panditer Bhita and the public approach to the memorial area.
